record_title: Rare-event Bernoulli TV: signed mass balance and proxy information loss
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The additive expansion is informative in the rare-event regime and may be non-sharp when the first-order discrepancy is smaller than the quadratic remainder. The factor-two obstruction applies only to methods retaining the sign-blind (lambda_i,a_i) representation, not to methods using the full Bernoulli parameter vectors. The optimal universal lower comparison constant for Smirnov's proxy and higher-order corrections are not determined. Older rare-event and Poisson-binomial signed-measure expansions remain a residual originality risk.
